info.title: ENS Indexer API
info.description: Read-only REST API over indexed ENS and Basenames state (Bigname v2-compatible wire shapes). Data responses are wrapped in `{data, page?, meta}` where `meta.as_of` reports the indexed chain heads and `meta.source` is `indexed`. Errors use `{error: {code, message, details}}`; unknown routes return 404 `not_found`. Every `/v2/*` route also answers under `/v1/*` for Bigname path compatibility.

get.summary: Profile of an address's primary name
Profiles of up to 10 names or addresses
Profile of a name or address

get.description: Checks database reachability with a 2 second `SELECT 1`. Ignores query parameters.

Chain-ordered events of the names an address currently relates to, plus the events that name the address directly: its primary-name claims (default relations and `scope=both`), its account approvals as owner or operator (`scope=both`), and its ENSv2 registry-root role changes (`role_holder` with `scope=both` or `scope=registration`). `relation` selects the related names: `owner` and `manager` from the current relation rows, `role_holder` from the address's current ENSv2 registry grants. Ended relations are not reproduced. `page.total_count` is null unless `include=total_count` asks for an exact count. Unknown or repeated query parameters return 400. Empty query values are treated as absent.

parameters.description: EVM address, `0x` + 40 hex (any case).

get.description: Paginated list of names where the address is the current owner (token holder), manager, or ENSv2 role holder; with `relation=resolves_to`, names whose current address record holds the address; with `relation=former_owner`, lapsed registrations the address last held. Unknown or repeated query parameters return 400. Empty query values are treated as absent.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: EVM address, `0x` + 40 hex (any case).

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Restrict to one configured namespace (`ens`, `basenames` by default). Default: all configured namespaces.

parameters.name: relation
parameters.description: Comma-separated subset of `owner`, `manager`, `role_holder`, or `any` for all three (default). `owner` is the token holder: the BaseRegistrar holder of an unwrapped ENSv1 `<label>.eth` name, else the NameWrapper or ENSv2 token holder, or the registry owner of a name without a token. A lapsed registration (an ENSv2 one from its expiry, any other once `released`) serves none of them. `role_holder` matches names whose current ENSv2 registration grants the address a registry role. `resolves_to` stands alone: resolution-supported names whose current `addr:<coin_type>` record holds the address. `former_owner` stands alone: lapsed registrations whose holder was the address, with `lapsed_registration`.

parameters.name: coin_type
parameters.description: Only with `relation=resolves_to`; any other relation returns 400. A decimal coin type from 1 to 4294967295 (default 60) adds `resolution: {coin_type, record_key}` to each row. The record key is `addr:2147483648` when the coin-60 answer is the ENSIP-19 default record. `evm` matches coin type 60 and every stored record from 2147483648 through 4294967295 and adds `resolutions`, one entry per matched stored record ascending by coin type.

parameters.name: authority
parameters.description: Comma-separated `ens_v0`, `ens_v1`, `ens_v2`: rows serving a listed `authority`. This deployment never serves `ens_v0`, so it matches nothing alone. Not accepted with `relation=former_owner`.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: A name: only names exactly one label below it (`parent=eth` lists `<label>.eth` names).

parameters.name: is_migrated
parameters.description: `true` keeps names migrated to ENSv2 (`migrated_at` set), `false` the others. Not accepted with `relation=resolves_to` or `relation=former_owner`.

parameters.name: expires_after
parameters.description: Only with `relation=former_owner`: inclusive lower bound on `expires_at`, decimal Unix seconds or RFC 3339.

parameters.name: expires_before
parameters.description: Only with `relation=former_owner`: exclusive upper bound on `expires_at`, decimal Unix seconds or RFC 3339.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: ENSIP-15 name fragment. `match` selects prefix or contains matching. Not accepted with `relation=former_owner`.

parameters.name: match
parameters.description: `prefix` (default) or `contains`. Ignored without `q`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `name` (default), `expires_at`, `registered_at`, or `created_at`; `relation=former_owner` sorts by `expires_at` only. Rows without the timestamp sort first ascending and last descending. Ties break by name and namespace.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: `asc` (default) or `desc`.

parameters.name: dedupe
parameters.description: `name` (default) or `registration`, which collapses rows sharing a registration to the one first by name. `relation=former_owner` accepts only `name`.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated `counts` (adds `subname_count` and `record_count`), `role_summary` (adds indexed permission grants and `record_count`), and `total_count`. `page.total_count` is exact while the address has at most 1,000 candidate names (10,000 with `total_count`) and `null` above; `resolves_to` and `former_owner` reads serve `null`. `total_count` with `relation=resolves_to` and any `include` with `relation=former_owner` return 400.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque `next_cursor` from a previous page. It must be replayed with the same filters, sort, and order.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 200, default 50.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Not supported; any non-empty value returns 400.

parameters.name: finality
parameters.description: Only `latest`; any other value returns 400.

get.description: Chain-ordered events across the decoded journals, filtered by name, address, registration, resolver, emitting contract, type, and block or timestamp windows. Filters intersect. `name` keeps the name-history rows of that name. `address` keeps the address-history rows of that address with `scope=both` and every relation. `registration_id` keeps one registration's rows, from its grant up to the next grant on the same resource. `resolver=<chain_id>:<address>` keeps rows that resolver emitted plus resolver-pointer rows whose new pointer is that resolver. `contract_address` keeps rows that contract emitted. `namespace` is inferred from `name`, spans every configured namespace for a bare `resolver`, and is otherwise `ens`. `page.total_count` is exact up to 10,000 rows when `name`, `registration_id`, `address` or `resolver` anchors the read, and null for unanchored reads. Unknown or repeated query parameters return 400. Empty query values are treated as absent.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: One configured namespace.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: ENS or Basenames name; must be a valid ENSIP-15 name.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: EVM address, `0x` + 40 hex (any case).

parameters.name: resolver
parameters.description: `<chain_id>:<address>` with chain 1, 8453, 11155111, or 84532.

parameters.name: contract_address
parameters.description: Emitting contract, `0x` + 40 hex (any case).

parameters.name: registration_id
parameters.description: Opaque registration handle, as `registration_id` on name and history rows.

parameters.name: to_block
parameters.description: Inclusive block upper bound.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Comma-separated friendly event types to include.

parameters.name: exclude_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated friendly event types to exclude. Exclusion wins.

parameters.name: kind

parameters.name: from_timestamp

parameters.name: to_timestamp

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated `data`, `raw`, `total_count`. `total_count` makes anchored counts exact, and counts `resolver`-only or `contract_address`-only reads up to 10,000 rows.

post.description: Resolves up to 1000 name and/or address inputs in one call, returning one result per input in request order with an in-band `status`. Accepts no query parameters. A body that is not valid JSON, is not sent as `application/json`, or does not match the schema returns 400 `malformed JSON request body`. A chain with no complete indexed head, or whose head is older than `MAX_AS_OF_AGE_SECONDS`, is temporarily unavailable: it is left out of `meta.as_of` and listed in `meta.as_of_completeness` (`completeness: unsupported`, `unsupported_reason: temporarily_unavailable`), its name inputs answer `not_found`, and reverse results omit its names.

400.description: `invalid_input`: any query parameter, a malformed body, or an invalid input value.

409.description: `conflict`: the request has address inputs and every configured chain is temporarily unavailable.

422.description: `unsupported`: a reverse result row belongs to a namespace this deployment does not serve.

get.summary: Names by expiry or grace deadline
get.description: Current names of one namespace whose finite `expires_at` or `grace_ends_at` falls in a half-open window, ordered by that deadline, then name bytes and namehash. Supply exactly one date family: scalar expiry bounds, repeated `expires_window`, scalar grace bounds, or repeated `grace_ends_window`. `order=desc` reverses only the deadline. Names without an expiry, or with a classified null expiry, never match; active, expired, and released names all do. Unknown query parameters, and repeats of any parameter but `expires_window` and `grace_ends_window`, return 400. Empty query values are treated as absent.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Required. One configured namespace (`ens`, `basenames` by default).

parameters.name: expires_after
parameters.description: Inclusive expiry lower bound, decimal Unix seconds or RFC 3339. One bound of one family is required.

parameters.name: expires_before
parameters.description: Exclusive expiry upper bound, decimal Unix seconds or RFC 3339. Must be later than `expires_after`.

parameters.name: expires_window
parameters.description: Repeat for 1 to 32 disjoint half-open expiry windows, each `after..before` in decimal Unix seconds or RFC 3339 (whitespace around a bound is ignored). Adjacent windows are allowed. Overlap, duplicates, a missing or malformed bound, `after >= before`, more than 32 windows, or any scalar expiry bound or grace parameter (even blank) return 400. Rows come in one sorted walk over every window and carry `expires_window_index`, the zero-based input position of their window.

parameters.name: grace_ends_after
parameters.description: Inclusive grace-deadline lower bound, decimal Unix seconds or RFC 3339. Cannot combine with expiry bounds.

parameters.name: grace_ends_before
parameters.description: Exclusive grace-deadline upper bound, decimal Unix seconds or RFC 3339. Must be later than `grace_ends_after`. Cannot combine with expiry bounds.

parameters.name: grace_ends_window
parameters.description: Repeat for 1 to 32 disjoint half-open grace-deadline windows, with the same rules as `expires_window`. Any scalar grace bound or expiry parameter (even blank) returns 400. Rows come in one sorted walk over every window and carry `grace_ends_window_index`, the zero-based input position of their window.

parameters.name: authority
parameters.description: Comma-separated set of `ens_v0`, `ens_v1`, `ens_v2`; keeps rows whose served `authority` is listed. This deployment never serves `ens_v0`, and Basenames rows serve no authority, so they match no set. Blank segments are skipped; an empty set or another value returns 400.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: A name. Only names exactly one label below it, by normalized name spelling, are listed. `parent=eth` lists every `<label>.eth` name and no deeper subname. An invalid name returns 400.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `expires_at` or `grace_ends_at`. Defaults to the supplied date family and must match it.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: `asc` (default) or `desc`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque `next_cursor` from a previous page; must be replayed with the same namespace, bounds or windows (in the same order), authority, parent, and order.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 200, default 50.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Not supported; any non-empty value returns 400.

parameters.name: finality
parameters.description: Only `latest`; any other value returns 400.

200.description: One page of names. `page.total_count` is null.

400.description: `invalid_input`: unknown, repeated, or malformed query parameters, a missing namespace or bound, mixed date families or windows with scalar bounds, invalid windows, a sort that does not match the bounds, bounds out of order, an invalid authority set or parent, or an invalid cursor.

409.description: `stale`: the namespace chain has no complete indexed head, or its head is older than `MAX_AS_OF_AGE_SECONDS`.

get.description: Current indexed state of one name in bigname's `NameRecord` shape: lifecycle `status`, `authority`, token-holder `owner`, `manager`, `ens_v1` facts, `lapsed_registration`, `migrated_at`, the ENSv2 `subregistry`, and grouped resolver `records`. `read_status` is `ok` for every served name; a custom resolver omits `records` and carries `resolution_unsupported_reason`, and a lapsed registration omits `owner`, `manager`, `resolver`, and `records`. An ENSv1-decided `.eth` name whose `<label>.eth` entry has no live ENSv2 registration or reservation at the chain head omits `resolver` and `records` and reports `unresolvable_reason: no_live_ens_v2_entry`. Unknown or repeated query parameters return 400. Empty query values are treated as absent.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: ENS or Basenames name; must be a valid ENSIP-15 name (normalized server-side).

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Override the namespace; default is inferred from the name (`*.base.eth` subdomains are `basenames`, everything else `ens`).

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: `indexed` (default) or `verified`. Both serve indexed state.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Snapshot selector; any non-empty value is rejected with 422 (snapshot reads not supported).

parameters.name: finality
parameters.description: `latest` (default) is served; `safe` and `finalized` return 422, other values 400.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated expansions; only `counts`. `counts` adds `subname_count` (direct children) and, when `records` is served, `record_count` (known record keys: address coin types, text keys, and contenthash). Other values return 400.

400.description: `invalid_input`: unknown, repeated, or malformed query parameters, or an invalid name.

409.description: `stale`: a required chain has no complete indexed head, or its head is older than `MAX_AS_OF_AGE_SECONDS`.

422.description: `unsupported`: `at` set, `finality` is `safe`/`finalized`, or the inferred namespace is not served.

get.description: Chain-ordered events of one name from the decoded journals: its registry, resolver, record and NameWrapper events and its registration resource events. `scope=name` and `scope=both` keep all of them; `scope=registration` drops ENSv2 reservations, which no registration carries. An ENSv1 `NewOwner` yields an `authority` row and a `subregistry` row; an ENSv2 registration emitted by the mainnet migration controller yields a `registration` row and a `migration` row. ENSv1 names match by namehash and registrar token. ENSv2 names match the registry entry of their current registration and its registry role resources. Basenames match by namehash and BaseRegistrar token. Primary-name, account-approval, registry-root and contract events never belong to a name. `name` is the requested name on every row. `page.total_count` is exact up to 10,000 rows and null above, unless `include=total_count` asks for an uncapped count. Unknown or repeated query parameters return 400. Empty query values are treated as absent.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: ENS or Basenames name; must be a valid ENSIP-15 name (normalized server-side).

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Override the namespace; default is inferred from the name.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: `name`, `registration`, or `both` (default). `registration` drops ENSv2 reservations.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Comma-separated friendly event types to include.

parameters.name: exclude_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated friendly event types to exclude. Exclusion wins.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Comma-separated raw event kinds to include. `PermissionScopeChanged`, `RolesChanged`, `RegistryCreated` and `Upgraded` return 422.

parameters.name: record_key
parameters.description: Exact stored record key such as `addr:60`, `text:avatar`, `contenthash` or `name`. Keeps writes of that key plus record-version resets.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: `desc` (default) or `asc`.

parameters.name: from_timestamp
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on the block timestamp: decimal Unix seconds or RFC 3339.

parameters.name: to_timestamp
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on the block timestamp: decimal Unix seconds or RFC 3339.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated `data`, `raw`, `total_count`, `child_registrations`. `child_registrations` merges the ENSv2 grants of registries the name's entry linked as its subregistry while linked (ENSv1 and Basenames subnames have no registration rows) and adds `subject` to every row; it returns 400 on `eth` and `base.eth`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque `next_cursor`; must be replayed with the same name, namespace, scope, order and filters.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 200, default 50.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Not supported; any non-empty value returns 400.

parameters.name: finality
parameters.description: Only `latest`; any other value returns 400.

200.description: One page of the name's events.

400.description: `invalid_input`: unknown, repeated, or malformed query parameters, an invalid name, or an invalid cursor.

404.description: `not_found`: the name is not indexed (first page only).

409.description: `stale`: a required chain has no complete indexed head, or its head is older than `MAX_AS_OF_AGE_SECONDS`.

422.description: `unsupported`: an unbacked type or kind, or a namespace this deployment does not serve.

get.description: Current indexed resolver records of one name as per-key answers. Without `keys`, `records` answers every stored key; with `keys`, each requested key answers `ok` with its value or `not_found`. A lapsed registration serves `resolver: null` and no stored value. A custom resolver (records not indexed) answers each requested key `unsupported`. `include=inventory` or `values=false` adds the record inventory. Unknown or repeated query parameters return 400. Empty query values are treated as absent.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: ENS or Basenames name; must be a valid ENSIP-15 name (normalized server-side).

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Override the namespace; default is inferred from the name (`*.base.eth` subdomains are `basenames`, everything else `ens`).

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: `indexed` (default) or `verified`. Both serve indexed state.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Snapshot selector; any non-empty value is rejected with 422 (snapshot reads not supported).

parameters.name: finality
parameters.description: `latest` (default) is served; `safe` and `finalized` return 422, other values 400.

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: Comma-separated record keys (at most 200, no duplicates): `addr:<coin_type>`, `text:<key>`, `avatar`, or `contenthash`. `records` answers exactly these keys. Must be omitted with `values=false` (400).

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: `true` (default) or `false`. `false` answers `records: {}` with the record inventory. Other values return 400.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated expansions; only `inventory`. Adds `inventory` (omitted for a lapsed registration): `known_keys` lists every stored record key (`addr:<coin_type>`, `text:<key>`, `contenthash`), `unset_keys` and `unsupported_keys` are empty, and `abi_content_types` is null because ABI records are not indexed. For a custom resolver `known_keys` is empty, `unsupported_keys` lists the requested keys, and `abi_unsupported_reason` is `inventory_not_authoritative`. Other values return 400.

400.description: `invalid_input`: unknown, repeated, or malformed query parameters, an invalid name, or invalid `keys`.

409.description: `stale`: a required chain has no complete indexed head, or its head is older than `MAX_AS_OF_AGE_SECONDS`.

422.description: `unsupported`: `at` set, `finality` is `safe`/`finalized`, or the inferred namespace is not served.

get.description: Direct children of one name (one label deep), sorted by `sort` and then byte-wise by name. `page.total_count` counts every child matching the `q`, `match`, and `include_expired` filters; it is exact up to 10,000 and `null` above. Unknown or repeated query parameters return 400. Empty query values are treated as absent.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Parent name; must be a valid ENSIP-15 name (normalized server-side).

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Namespace of the children; default is inferred from a child name (children of `base.eth` are `basenames`, everything else follows the parent).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Child name text, normalized as an ENSIP-15 name fragment. One trailing dot marks a label boundary (`q=alpha.` matches `alpha.parent.eth` but not `alphax.parent.eth`). With `match=contains`, one leading dot is also kept. Input the normalizer rejects returns 400.

parameters.name: match
parameters.description: `prefix` (default) matches the start of the child name. `contains` matches `q` anywhere in it. Other values return 400. Ignored without `q`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `name` (default), `expires_at`, or `registered_at`. Timestamp sorts use the child's own timestamp. A child without it sorts first ascending and last descending. Ties break by name. Other values return 400.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: `asc` (default) or `desc`.

parameters.name: include_expired
parameters.description: `true` (default) lists every child. `false` omits children whose `status` is `expired` or `released` at the chain head timestamp, with the same expiry and grace boundaries as `status`.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated expansions; only `counts`, which adds each row's `subname_count`. Other values return 400.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque `next_cursor` from a previous page; must be replayed with the same name, namespace, q, match, sort, include_expired, and order.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Page size from 1 to 200, default 50.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Not supported; any non-empty value returns 400.

parameters.name: finality
parameters.description: Only `latest`; any other value returns 400.

400.description: `invalid_input`: unknown, repeated, or malformed query parameters, an invalid name or q, or an invalid cursor.

404.description: `not_found`: the name is not indexed and has no indexed children.

409.description: `stale`: a required chain has no complete indexed head, or its head is older than `MAX_AS_OF_AGE_SECONDS`.

get.description: A namespace this deployment serves: its network and chain, and the capabilities served for every name in it (`name_profile` follows `GET /v2/names/{name}`, `name_history` follows `GET /v2/names/{name}/history`). Reads no indexed state, so `meta.as_of` is omitted. Accepts no query parameters.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Namespace, such as `ens` or `basenames`.

400.description: `invalid_input`: any query parameter.

404.description: `not_found`: this deployment does not serve the namespace.

get.summary: Current permission rows by name, registration, address, or ENSv2 registry
get.description: At least one selector is required. Name selects only its current registration. Explicit registration and address reads are resource audits. Registry selects the current holders of the registry's root resource and cannot be combined with name or registration_id. Latest state only, with no as-of claim. ENSv1 registry, registrar, wrapper, and supported resolver authorities are combined with ENSv2 roles. Argument-scoped ENSv2 resolver grants are not represented. `meta.completeness=partial` with `unsupported_reason=permissions_partially_listed` lists in `meta.unlisted_permission_surfaces` the surfaces the rows do not enumerate: a RootRegistry or ETHRegistry read lists none and omits the three fields; another registry reports `ens_v2_registry_operators`; an ENSv2 registration `resolver_approvals` (plus `ens_v2_registry_operators` on a discovered registry); a NameWrapper registration `resolver_approvals` and `wrapper_parent_control`; any other registration `registrar_approvals` and `resolver_approvals`; an address-only read all four. A name or registration_id that selects no current registration keeps `unsupported_reason=permission_support_unknown`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Normalized ENS name selecting its current registration.

parameters.name: registration_id

get.description:
Current names whose stored normalized name starts with (`match=prefix`) or contains (`match=contains`) the normalized `q`, or whose first label is within one edit of `q` (`match=fuzzy`), ordered by name bytes, then namespace and namehash. `q` is normalized as an ENSIP-15 name fragment. One trailing dot is kept as a label boundary. With `match=contains`, one leading dot is also kept. Names longer than 2000 bytes are never results. Rows omit `lapsed_registration`, `expires_window_index`, and `grace_ends_window_index`. Unknown or repeated query parameters return 400. Empty query values are treated as absent. A chain with no complete indexed head, or whose head is older than `MAX_AS_OF_AGE_SECONDS`, is temporarily unavailable: its namespace's rows are withheld, it is left out of `meta.as_of`, and it is listed in `meta.as_of_completeness` (`completeness: unsupported`, `unsupported_reason: temporarily_unavailable`). An explicit `namespace` on such a chain returns an empty page.

`match=fuzzy` finds misspelled names. One edit is one inserted, deleted, substituted, or transposed character, so `q=vitalk` returns `vitalik.eth`, `bitalk.eth`, and `vital.eth`. It compares only the first label, so subnames such as `vitalik.example.eth` also match. Results keep name order, not closeness order. `q` must be a single label of at least 3 characters. The server must run with `SEARCH_BM25=true`; otherwise `match=fuzzy` returns 400.
